description: Land Reform Commission - Directed persons to claim compensations in respect of the lands in Ingiriya, Kalutara District and Thillawatawana, Hambantota District and Thempana Pilassa, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is issued by the Land Reform Commission under the Land Reform Law, calling for claims on compensation for agricultural lands that have been vested in the Commission. The content deals exclusively with land acquisition, ownership claims, and compensation procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
